examples.question_text: By rounding each number to one significant figure, estimate $42\times197$.
By rounding each number to one significant figure, estimate $1818\div6$. Give your estimate to $2$ decimal places.
By rounding each number to one significant figure, estimate $64\times29$.
By rounding each number to one significant figure, estimate $31\times204$.

By rounding each number to one significant figure, estimate:
(a) $1423\div7$, giving your estimate to $2$ decimal places.
(b) $1756\div4$.
